text: Settings Search has been massively improved.
subpoints: A complete overhaul of the settings search has taken place. Search results look good, work consistently, and even allow for small typos.
If you find any settings that were missed, please report them on the GitHub page. Once I'm done crying, I'll add them to the search database.
Find this in SpeakThat! Settings.
Cancel readouts early by dismissing the notification.
This works very well for smartwatches, allowing you to discreetly cancel readouts from your wrist.
Find this in Behaviour Settings.
Space consecutive digits out to prevent them being read as one long number.
You can also decide what character is used as a separator. Use a space for a short pause, a comma for a medium pause, or a full-stop for a long pause.
Find this in Filter Settings underneath the Tidy Speech section.
Allows you to stop readouts using a broadcast intent from a third-party app.
A key is required for this, so SpeakThat will generate one for you, which you must enter as an additional value in your automation app.
Find this in Development Settings.

text: Fixed SelfTest not recognising Content Cap.
subpoints: Running SelfTest with Content Cap set to a short timed duration so that the test notification doesn't finish caused the SelfTest to hang until it hit its 60-second limit. This has been fixed.
Thanks to ForgeSource for the bug report!

text: Fixed Conditional Rules not being selected after importing a configuration that uses them.
subpoints: When importing a configuration file with Conditional Rules, they now get re-enabled by default rather than you needing to manually turn it back on.
Took me long enough to get this one patched out, honestly...

text: Fixed Auto-Language not being enabled during settings import.
subpoints: I'm not sure why this option wasn't included when importing a setting configuration, but it is now.
Shesh, how many things are missed when importing a configuration? If you find anymore, do let me know. You'll be credited for the fix lol

text: Fixed Advanced Voice Options showing uninstalled voices.
subpoints: The spinner for selecting a specific voice previously displayed voices that weren't installed on the device. This has been corrected.
